new_findings.title: HTML score report omits the embedding-backed recall limitation
new_findings.defect: The plan requires detection values to be labeled as embedding-backed public-export measurements, but the generated HTML includes no estimand caveat.
new_findings.failure_scenario: An operator opens report.html and reads detection_recall@frame_e2e/label_map_primary as detector-only recall even though faces without embeddings never appear in the public export rows being scored.
new_findings.fix: Add a visible report note that detection P/R measures end-to-end embeddable-face yield among public exports, and assert the note in the mocked report test.

summary: Seventeen findings rechecked: seven hold, nine are partial, and one remains unfixed; the literal v3 fixture is still unloadable.
